title: Perfect complex over the coefficient ring on $X$
statement:
In the Poincare duality conventions [def-pod-conventions] of this chapter (the fixed setting), let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$, with $D^b_{ctf}$ as in [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Then $K$ is *perfect over $\Lambda_X$* if it is quasi-isomorphic, locally on the small pro-etale site of $X$, to a bounded complex of finite projective $\Lambda_X$-modules.

The coefficient-stage interpretation of this local condition is precisely site-perfectness [def-weil-site-perfect-complex]: at finite level use direct summands of finite sums of the coefficient sheaf; at the integral stage use the completed coefficient sheaf; at the rational stage take the summands in the localized category; and at the common $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ stage require a site-perfect representative over some finite extension. The condition here is restricted to the objects $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ in the fixed Poincare setting.
